headline: MENJ.BUZZ launches as a single entity hub
summary: Mohd Elfie Nieshaem Juferi has consolidated his publishing, apologetics and development work behind a single address.
body: The new site gathers a decade and a half of work across search, comparative religion, Malay literature and open-source development, and links every profile and property under one identity record.
The site is static, flat-file and dependency-free, with content maintained as JSON and rendered at build time.
boilerplate: Mohd Elfie Nieshaem Juferi is an SEO specialist, Muslim apologist, publisher and developer based in Kuala Lumpur.
